title: Webhooks
intro: Events from Stripe, Checkr and Resend go through an inbox: each is recorded once, retried when processing fails, and listed here when it keeps failing.
failingIntro: Dead events have no more automatic tries. Replay one once the cause is fixed, or dismiss it when nothing more is needed. Both are logged.
cannotReplay: Can't be replayed here: the provider's keys aren't set. Resend it from the provider's dashboard.

result.notAllowed: This event can't be changed. It may have moved on: refresh the page.
result.failedAgain: It failed again. The error above is the latest.
